description: RFC 6962 Merkle root over five leaves (exercises orphan promotion for an odd, non-power-of-two leaf count). Generated by warrantor-trust-core::merkle::merkle_root. Cross-language implementations (Python, Go) must produce the identical root for the same leaf set. This complements merkle-001.json (which uses four leaves, a power of two) by covering the odd-leaf-count path.
ordering: RFC 6962 — leaf=SHA-256(0x00 || leaf), node=SHA-256(0x01 || left || right), orphan-promotion for odd layers (5 leaves -> 3 nodes -> 2 nodes -> 1 root)
notes: The Rust unit test in rust/trust-core/src/merkle.rs::golden_vector_merkle_001 locks the four-leaf case; this vector locks the five-leaf (orphan-promotion) case for cross-language conformance. The conformance runner computes the root over leaves_hex in Python and Go and compares to expected_root_hex.
